title: Meeting Rooms II
keyIdea: Process meetings by start time. Keep a min-heap of the end times of busy rooms. If the room that frees earliest is free by this meeting's start, reuse it (pop); then push this meeting's end. The largest heap size is the number of rooms needed.

approaches.name: Sort + min-heap of end times
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). Sort by start; pop the top if top ≤ start; push end; rooms = max(rooms, heap size).
approaches.why: Sort plus one heap push and at most one pop per meeting; the heap holds up to n ends.

quiz.q: Why look only at the heap's top (earliest end)?
options: If even the earliest-ending room is busy, all rooms are busy
The top is the newest meeting

quiz.q: A meeting ends at 10 and the next starts at 10. Same room?
options: Yes: top ≤ start, so pop and reuse
Only if they are the same length

quiz.q: Another way to get the same answer?
options: Sort starts and ends separately and sweep with two pointers, tracking the most rooms in use
Binary search on the answer only
